title: Account Coordinator
description:
Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator)

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,700 per annum
Hours: 40 hours per week
Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activities by sourcing and coordinating suitable candidates.
- Conduct candidate registrations and onboarding processes.
- Deliver worker inductions and site briefings.
- Complete compliance checks, right-to-work verification, and employment documentation.
- Maintain accurate records using Stafforce's internal systems and databases.
- Update and manage workforce data using Microsoft Excel and other software packages.
- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
- Travel between client sites and offices as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong IT and administrative skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident using databases, software systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- A flexible and positive approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in recruitment, account coordination, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
- Experience working with temporary workers or high-volume staffing environments.
- Full UK driving licence due to travel requirements across multiple client locations in the Hull area.

What You'll Receive

In return, Stafforce offers a supportive environment where you can develop your career and make a real difference to both candidates and clients.

Benefits Include:
- Competitive salary of 27,700 per annum.
- Full training and ongoing development opportunities.
- Career progression within a well-established and growing business.
- 24/7 GP access through our employee wellbeing programme.
- Emotional wellbeing and mental health support.
- High street discounts across a wide range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers, and services.
- Access to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

S15

About Us

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant
Location: Hull
Salary: £35,000 - £38,000 per annum

Make an impact at the heart of a successful professional services business
Consortium Professional Recruitment are pleased to be working with an established and respected professional services organisation to recruit an Executive Assistant. This newly created position offers the opportunity to work closely with the Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team, providing trusted support while helping the wider business stay organised, connected and effective.
This is a varied role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, managing competing priorities and being a dependable point of support. You will combine executive assistance with wider business coordination, working across administration, communications, recruitment, events and external supplier relationships.
The Opportunity:
As an Executive Assistant, you ll play a key role in:
- Providing proactive and confidential support to the Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team, including selected strategic matters.
- Preparing high-quality reports, presentations, meeting papers and action trackers.
- Coordinating projects, business administration, audio typing, document production and secretarial cover.
- Supporting internal communications and business planning, helping information and actions move effectively across the organisation.
- Coordinating external marketing, PR, website and design suppliers, alongside client and staff events, recruitment, onboarding, AML and GDPR administration.

Your work will directly contribute to stronger organisation, greater leadership capacity and effective day-to-day business operations.
About You:
We re looking for someone who can bring:
- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, PA or in a senior business support position.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively and coordinate varied activities.
- Clear and confident communication skills, together with a professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.
- Strong Microsoft 365 skills and previous audio typing experience.
- A proactive, dependable approach and the confidence to take ownership of tasks while working collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.

Experience within professional services would be beneficial, although it is not essential.
The Benefits and Package:
In return, you ll enjoy:
- £35,000 - £38,000 per annum.
- 37.5 hours per week.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- A newly created role with the opportunity to provide meaningful support across leadership and wider business activities.

How to Apply:
This exciting Executive Assistant opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach. If you re ready to take the next step in your career, we d love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.
Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. title: HR Co-ordinator
description:
Role: HR Co-ordinator (People and Culture)

Sector: Public Sector

Duration: 12 months FTC

Location: Hull

Salary: up to £34,434 per annum (DOE)

Sellick Partnership is currently recruiting for an experienced HR Co-ordinator to join our client based in Hull, working on a hybrid basis for a 12 month fixed term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a HR professional looking for a varied role covering all aspects of human resources within a fast-paced and people-focused environment.

The HR Co-ordinator will work closely with managers and employees across the organisation, providing comprehensive HR support throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring HR processes are delivered efficiently, professionally and in line with

Key responsibilities for theHR Co-ordinator will include;
- Supporting the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment through to leaving
- Supporting recruitment campaigns, interviews, onboarding and pre-employment checks
- Providing first-line HR advice and guidance to managers and employees
- Managing HR administration including contracts, variations, employment documentation and record keeping
- Supporting employee relations cases including absence management, disciplinaries, grievances and performance management
- Assisting with workforce planning and organisational change activity
- Maintaining HR systems and ensuring employee data is accurate and compliant
- Supporting learning and development initiatives and training administration
- Producing HR reports and workforce data to support decision making
- Monitoring compliance with employment legislation, policies and procedures
- Contributing to HR projects and continuous improvement activities
- Supporting wellbeing, engagement and inclusion initiatives across the organisation

The Ideal candidate for the HR Co-ordinator will;
- Previous experience within a HR generalist role covering a broad range of HR activities
- Knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple properties
- Experience of supporting in employee relations matters

The HR Co-ordinator will need to have excellent communication skills and effectively be able to communicate to stakeholders of all levels. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have an impeccable eye for detail and accuracy to ensure all workload is carried out effectively and efficiently. They will also need to able to prioritise their workload and be efficient and effective to meet unpredictable deadlines and deal with conflicting demands, whilst working in a high-pressured environment.

Our client is hoping to have the HR Co-ordinator in the role as soon as possible, therefore if you believe your experience meets the criteria above, please contact Charlotte Broomfield or Tim Farnsworth by Friday 4 September by 10am by submitting your CV directly.

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Quotations & Estimating Coordinator
description:
Are you an experienced Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Costing Coordinator or Commercial Coordinator looking for your next opportunity within a manufacturing business in the Hull area?

Do you enjoy working with detailed information, building accurate quotations and making sure every element of a customer requirement has been properly costed?

If so, this Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job in Hull could be a really good next step.

Our client is an established manufacturing business with a strong reputation for producing bespoke solutions for its customers. Due to a recent change within the team, they are now looking for a Quotations & Estimating Coordinator to join their Commercial department.

You ll be working closely with Account Management, Commercial and operational teams, turning customer requirements into accurate, competitive quotations. It s a role that needs someone who enjoys detail, understands how costs come together and can manage a busy workload without losing accuracy.

What the Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job involves

You ll be responsible for producing accurate and timely customer quotations, taking into account all of the different elements required to deliver each project.
- Producing accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Reviewing customer briefs and information supplied by the Account Management team.
- Calculating costs across areas such as materials, design work, labour, production time and other associated costs.
- Creating bespoke quotations based on individual customer requirements.
- Prioritising estimates according to customer needs and commercial deadlines.
- Supporting Account Management and Business Development with quotations for both new and existing customers.
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and colleagues across the wider business where further information is required.
- Maintaining accurate information within the company s CRM and estimating systems.
- Helping to ensure consistency across pricing and estimating processes.

The role plays an important part in supporting both existing customers and new business opportunities.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with numbers and detailed information, and takes real pride in accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within estimating, quotations, costing, pricing, commercial coordination or a similar role.
- Experience within manufacturing, print, packaging, engineering or another production environment would be advantageous.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence working with detailed cost information.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong data processing and analytical skills.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills and confidence liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments.
- A structured and process-driven approach.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Experience using CRM or estimating software would be beneficial.
- A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across the team.

We are particularly looking for someone who is accurate, adaptable, able to work under pressure and comfortable managing changing priorities.

You may currently be working as a Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Cost Estimator, Manufacturing Estimator, Commercial Coordinator, Pricing Coordinator, Costing Coordinator, Sales Estimator or Commercial Estimator and be looking for your next opportunity in the Hull area.

Other information
- Hours: 9.00am 5.30pm
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to buy up to five additional days.
- Auto-enrolment pension.
- Regular company events and social activities throughout the year.
- Free on-site parking.
- Christmas Eve and New Year s Eve early finish, subject to business requirements.
- Opportunity to join an established manufacturing business with a strong emphasis on integrity, teamwork and sustainability.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive, if you have not heard from us within two weeks, please assume you have not been shortlisted for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data.
